# Brightpath Academy

An online course platform. Instructors publish self-paced courses made of ordered lessons; a lesson is a video or a
written page and can end with a short quiz. Learners browse the catalogue by category, enroll in a course, follow its
lessons in order, mark lessons complete and pick up where they left off. Each learner sees their progress per course.
Learners can ask questions under a lesson and other learners or the instructor answer. After finishing a course a
learner can rate it with stars and a short review. An admin manages categories and can unpublish a course.

Look: calm and studious, plenty of white space, a deep teal accent.
